---
title: Sidenotes beside their lines
description: A paragraph citing footnotes far down it, for the sidenotes' place in the margin.
date: 2026-11-05
---

The first sentence cites a footnote.[^1] Then the paragraph goes on for a while, line after line, so that what it cites next is well below its top: it says a little more, and then a little more again, and then more still, with nothing in particular to say, until it is long enough to cite another. Here is the sentence that cites the second footnote[^2] at last. And one after it.

[^1]: The first footnote, in the right margin.
[^2]: The second footnote, in the left margin.
